user.title: Connect SmartSolar
user.description: Enter the API key for your inverter. Generate it in the SmartSolar iSetting panel by enabling API Access.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter SmartSolar API key
reauth_confirm.description: The SmartSolar API key was rejected. Enter a new key for this inverter.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid, or API access is disabled for this device.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartSolar server.
error.rate_limited: The device is temporarily rate-limited by SmartSolar. Try again in an hour.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from the SmartSolar API.

abort.wrong_device: That API key belongs to a different inverter.

init.title: SmartSolar options
init.description: SmartSolar allows 30 requests per minute per device; exceeding it disables API access for an hour, and repeated violations disable it permanently. Usage, faults and settings are polled on fixed slow schedules.

data.hide_grid_alerts: Hide grid alerts in the fault report
